name: blake3
algorithm: BLAKE3 hashing (32-byte digest) over a generated multi-MiB SplitMix64 buffer: bulk_reps full-buffer passes plus short_reps passes over 64-byte slices, XOR-folding the first 8 little-endian bytes of every digest into a u64 checksum (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses bitwise XOR and wrapping SplitMix64; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares standard library BLAKE3 implementations; XOR-folding every digest checks that both implementations produced identical BLAKE3 outputs
notes: Combines both bulk throughput (bulk_reps full-buffer passes over mib MiB) and short-message overhead (short_reps passes hashing every 64-byte slice), mutating one buffer byte after each pass so no hash can be hoisted.
